details: zzsouthrunner 1.0.1 and 1.0.2 (2026-05-12). Its .yardopts uses --load to run script.rb when YARD builds the gem's documentation, which gave the publisher code execution on RubyDoc.info's documentation build workers. The script, commented "malicious crawler/exfil for Southwark Jan 2026 docs via rubydoc.info worker", crawls council websites from the worker and publishes the results to RubyGems as a new gem with an embedded API key. Documented in the rubyhack.ai research by Spencer Kitts, Thomas Larsen and Sydney Von Arx (2026-09-11). The gem has been removed from RubyGems.
